files.README.md:
# Ottertail Kayaks - autumn booking sheet

One row per booking. tour is the booked tour exactly as named on the
sheet; paddlers is the party size. Cancellations are removed before
the sheet is exported.
files.notes/dock.txt:
Dock notes
- Light racks go out with the first trip.
- The boathouse ramp is reserved for the school groups.
